front.title: Applicability of ACTN to Multi-Domain Deterministic Networking

abstract.t:
End-to-end Deterministic Networking (DetNet) services may span multiple network domains using different technologies and controlled by independent domain-specific mechanisms. Coordinating these services requires an approach to abstract network resources and capabilities while preserving the requested service objectives across domain boundaries.
This document investigates the applicability of the Abstraction and Control of Traffic Engineering Networks (ACTN) framework to multi- domain DetNet. It describes a functional mapping between ACTN entities and the DetNet Controller Plane, and considers the information needed for domain abstraction, service objective coordination and monitoring. It identifies areas for further work and questions for discussion in the DetNet and TEAS Working Groups.
